summary: {member} takes responsibility for getting public comments into the board's new website by the deadline the board set.
realLife: Rita Laws and Ute Wartenberg were assigned to work with Mint technicians after members approved a website with a way for visitors to submit comments and set a July deadline.
inGame: needs: the website deadline and the address that receives submissions.

turns.pulledBy: Staff can test the public form before launch.
turns.what: The board members send a test comment.
turns.writesBack: The launch review includes the reply address.

turns.pulledBy: The form cannot deliver to the committee.
turns.writesBack: The members bring the failure to technical staff.
